items.title: Franklin Templeton just updated its crypto ETF. Here's what you should know.
items.summary:
Scott Melker explains why Franklin Templeton (BEN) just added Hyperliquid (HYPE32196-USD) to its crypto exchange-traded fund (ETF), which holds coins such as bitcoin (BTC-USD), ether (ETH-USD), solana (SOL-USD), XRP (XRP), and more.

"The Daily Wolf with Scott Melker" airs every day at 12:00 p.m. Tune in for your daily dose of all things crypto.

items.title: Franklin Templeton's Araghi Sees AI Selloff as Market Reset
items.summary: Franklin Templeton portfolio manager Sara Araghi says the sharp tech selloff reflects an unwinding of earlier AI euphoria rather than a fundamental deterioration in demand. She discusses why AI infrastructure spending remains strong, the growing focus on proving returns from that investment and why she still views Anthropic's record IPO as a success despite shares falling below their offering price. She joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech."

items.title: BlackRock Stock And Bond Funds Investors Are Watching As Tech Fear Grows
items.summary: Panic is creeping through growth stocks as AI optimism cools, the Nasdaq slides roughly 10% in a week, and fears of fresh Fed rate hikes push investors toward safety. While tech high-flyers wobble, short-duration investment-grade corporate bond funds can look like a calm harbor. This article walks through three stocks exposed to that fear trade and explains how they might fit, or clash, with a portfolio built for steadier income.
